introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms stretched forward, then lower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. 

Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes. Return to the start position and do the next rep. 

This works the thighs, hips buttocks, quads, hamstrings and lower body.
name: SQUATS

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your glutes.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If it's too easy for you, go lower for a deep squat.
If you feel it's too hard, widen your feet to get more balance.
This works on all the muscles of your lower body.
This exercise will help you get good balance.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under butt and your hands under shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: DONKEY KICKS LEFT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Then lift one leg up while raising your hips off the floor as high as you can. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.
name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your spine straight when lifting your hips.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't bend your lifted leg.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too easy, don't make your hips touch the floor.
If you feel it's too hard, put both feet on the floor.
You shouldn't feel stress in your back, neck and shoulder area.
This exercise not only works on your glutes, but also your abs and hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Then lift one leg up while raising your hips off the floor as high as you can. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat with the other side.
name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your spine straight when lifting your hips.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't bend your lifted leg.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too easy, don't make your hips touch the floor.
If you feel it's too hard, put both feet on the floor.
You shouldn't feel stress in your back, neck and shoulder area.
This not only works on your glutes, but also your abs and hamstrings.

introduce:
Stand on the floor, then bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. 

Hold this position for a few seconds, then change sides and repeat.

Your lifted knee should always go straight down, and your upper body should keep straight during the exercise.
name: QUAD STRETCH

tips.text: Please keep your chest open.
The knee of your lifted leg should always point straight toward the ground.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Exhale as you lift one foot up behind you and bring it towards your buttocks.
Inhale as you lower your foot back down to the ground.
This exercise works on your quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.

introduce: Start with your left knee and your hands on a bench, put your hands directly under your shoulders. \n\nThen kick your right leg back until it is parallel with the ground. Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: BENCH GLUTE KICK BACK RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a bench.
Your toes should point toward the floor.
Keep your right leg straight.
Your hands should be directly under your shoulders.
Keep your back flat.
Put your weight on your wrists.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
You shouldn't feel any strain in your back.
This exercise is going to give you a sexy butt.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.
